resources.string: Export or restore French and English progress

The file contains games, history, Elo, puzzles, NAB’s Workshop, coins, tickets, themes and the local profile for both languages. It may contain your photo and profile details. Keep it somewhere private. Friends sign-ins stay on their original device.
This backup replaces the current local progress for both languages. Export your current progress first if you want to keep it.
The Android file picker is unavailable.
Could not create the backup. Check available storage and the selected folder.
Could not restore this file. Select a valid Tibop backup and check available storage.

Your games, Elo, profile photo, country, age and gender stay on the device. You choose where to save a transfer file and who receives a shared score card. NAB explains moves on the device. When you open a definition, your browser looks up the selected word on Wiktionary.

In Friends, your group’s server stores your nickname, account, invitations and online results. You can delete this account in Friends. Google sign-in is optional and depends on your server configuration.

Rewarded videos are optional. When enabled, the Google SDK handles the ad request and privacy choices. Ad privacy options appear in Settings when the SDK makes them available.
A restore was interrupted. Free up storage if needed, then try recovering your previous progress again.
